methodology.scope: Separate single Pages observation with Google Maps public iframe origins allowed; no private accounts, writes, or field p75.
methodology.order: one Pages navigation with Google Maps allowed; NOT included in the three-pair comparison
methodology.cache: disabled via CDP; fresh anonymous context for every navigation
methodology.proxy: Default Chrome system proxy behavior, CDP proxy phase recorded; no no-proxy flag and no system changes
methodology.network: Actual network/CDN/TLS plus CDP-added40ms latency,10Mbps download,5Mbps upload; no CPU throttle
methodology.guards: Only exact Render/Pages/Supabase and listed public Google iframe origins allowed; non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS denied; all other origins blocked.
methodology.readiness: load, then four cards and session role marker, then networkidle; no input/click/focus
methodology.lcp: Last observed LCP candidate, not field p75; no synthetic interactions.
methodology.bytes: CDP loadingFinished.encodedDataLength sum for allowed origins including HTML/API/images; unfinished/failed responses may be incomplete.
methodology.sanitization: Only public origin labels/pathnames and safe cache/content/server/CORS headers; no raw query values, cookies, authorization, response bodies, tokens or personal data.
